definitions.meaning: to jeer or heckle a speaker or team noisily
lodgings for a private, the lowest-ranking soldier

explanation.walkthrough: 'Private' looks like an adjective meaning personal, but it is the soldier of that rank.
explanation.definitionFit: Jeering at someone shows hostility, and soldiers are housed in military quarters, so the word fits both senses.

clue.text: Company that was floated to avoid liquidation ended up here

definitions.text: Company that was floated to avoid liquidation ended up here

parts.words: Company that was floated to avoid liquidation ended up here
parts.note: reads like a business floated on the stock market to escape being wound up, but describes Noah's family and animals afloat to escape the Flood, coming to rest on a mountain

explanation.surface: A firm floated on the market to dodge being wound up finally settled somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: In Genesis, Noah's ark came to rest on the mountains of this name after the Flood; 'liquidation' is the drowning by water, 'floated' the ark afloat.
explanation.definitionFit: Biblical tradition places the resting place of Noah's ark on this Turkish mountain.

indicators.note: the word for standing up holds the next piece inside it, as in a hug

parts.note: stood up means rose, got to one's feet
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone got to their feet and hugged a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A common female first name, so an example of a girl.

indicators.note: about here signals the letters of the following word being turned around and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone was warned regarding schooling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like 'concerning', but it rearranges EDUCATION.
explanation.definitionFit: To be cautioned is to receive a formal warning, as from police.

clue.text: The woman with two articles to stow away safely

parts.note: the woman is the pronoun she
the two articles are the indefinite a and the definite the
the two articles are the indefinite a and the definite the

explanation.surface: A woman with a couple of items wants to put them away securely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'two articles' looks like two objects, but means the grammar words A and THE.
explanation.definitionFit: To put a blade in its scabbard is to store it away safely.

clue.text: God willing, it's all right to admit artist and composer

parts.note: DV abbreviates Deo volente, Latin for God willing

indicators.note: to admit means the okay letters let the artist in between them

parts.note: it's all right means OK
RA, Royal Academician, is the usual crossword artist

explanation.surface: God willing, it is acceptable to let in a painter and a musician.
explanation.walkthrough: 'artist and composer' looks like a pair of definitions, but the artist is wordplay and only the composer defines.
explanation.definitionFit: Antonin Dvorak was a Czech composer, best known for the New World Symphony.

definitions.meaning: boring a hole, done with a tool that bores
the marching and parade exercise soldiers practise

explanation.walkthrough: 'Boring' reads as dull, a sly comment on army routine, but it means making holes.
explanation.definitionFit: The same word is a tool for making holes and the military exercise of marching in formation.

parts.note: open means overt, not hidden
urns are containers, vases

explanation.surface: Someone tips over containers that have been left open.
explanation.walkthrough: 'open' looks like a verb or an adjective on the containers, but it is a separate piece.
explanation.definitionFit: To upset something is to knock it over or overturn it; also to reverse a decision.

clue.text: Four in new search for data

indicators.note: in means the numeral goes inside the rearranged letters
new signals the letters of the following word made new, reordered

parts.note: IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Four people take part in a fresh hunt for information.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' turns SEARCH into ARCHES; 'Four' looks like people, but it is the Roman numeral.
explanation.definitionFit: Archives are stored records, a collection of documents and data.

clue.text: It may be recommended as a sun resort

definitions.text: It may be recommended as a sun resort

indicators.note: resort read as re-sort, sort again, tells you to rearrange the three words before it

explanation.surface: A travel agent might recommend this as a sunny holiday spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' does double duty in the reading: re-sorting AS A SUN gives the place, and the whole clue describes it as a sun resort.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital of the Bahamas is a well-known Caribbean holiday destination for sun-seekers.

parts.note: people called to a trial come into court to provide testimony

explanation.surface: Witnesses turn up to give something.
explanation.definitionFit: Testimony given by witnesses in court is a form of proof presented to the jury.

parts.note: reads like a Restoration play staged in a theatre, but means renewing a face in an operating theatre

explanation.surface: A Restoration comedy is featured at a playhouse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Restoration' and 'theatre' suggest Restoration drama; the features are facial and the theatre is surgical.
explanation.definitionFit: Cosmetic surgery that tightens facial skin, restoring a youthful look.

clue.text: Go flat out to arrange a tenancy and rent

parts.note: to let property is to arrange a tenancy
rent, as in a torn hole, is a rip

explanation.surface: A landlord rushes to set up a lease and charge rent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rent' looks like the money paid by a tenant, but it is a tear.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to go at full speed, holding nothing back.

indicators.note: uneasy signals the following letters are unsettled, put into a different order

explanation.surface: Feeling nervous about going into a dark place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Uneasy entering dark' reads as someone nervously walking into darkness, but 'Uneasy' rearranges ENTERING DARK.
explanation.definitionFit: A nursery class that prepares young children for formal schooling.

indicators.note: say signals that the words are spoken, giving something with the same sound

parts.note: halls of residence at Keele, a university in Staffordshire, England

explanation.surface: Floor coverings for student accommodation, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Carpets' looks like floor coverings, but here means rebukes severely. Keele University is in Staffordshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: To carpet someone is to give a dressing-down; the naval punishment of dragging under a ship's keel is used figuratively for this.

indicators.note: treatment of the two words before works them over, giving their letters a new order

explanation.surface: Someone refuses that a small pet dog was handled harshly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rough treatment' reads as one phrase, but 'rough' belongs to the letters rearranged with DENY.
explanation.definitionFit: A racing dog runs laps of a track, so it is a lap-dog in a playful sense.

clue.text: Relating complicated involvement of two men and a woman

definitions.text: involvement of two men and a woman

indicators.note: complicated signals the letters of the first word are tangled into another order

explanation.surface: Telling a messy story of a love affair among three people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'complicated' looks like it describes the involvement, but it rearranges RELATING.
explanation.definitionFit: A love triangle is a romantic entanglement among three people.

clue.text: Rows among Quakers end in cordiality

indicators.note: among puts the rows inside the word for Quakers

parts.note: the Religious Society of Friends is the Quakers' formal name
rows are lines

explanation.surface: Arguments among members of a peaceful religious group finally end in goodwill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rows' looks like quarrels, rhyming with cows, but it means lines.
explanation.definitionFit: Cordiality is warmth and amiability, a friendly manner.

clue.text: Fancy a title for a Lennon song

definitions.meaning: to fancy is to suppose or picture in the mind

definitions.text: a title for a Lennon song

explanation.definitionFit: To fancy something is to picture it in the mind, and that verb is also a famous John Lennon song title.

clue.text: Penny puts on weight in spring

indicators.note: puts on means the penny is placed on top of the weight in this down entry

parts.note: an ounce is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: A girl called Penny gains weight in the springtime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Penny' looks like a girl's name, and 'spring' the season; it is the verb to leap.
explanation.definitionFit: To spring on prey is to leap suddenly at it.

definitions.meaning: to get to the bottom of, understand
a unit used to measure depth of water, six feet

explanation.definitionFit: The word means to understand fully and is also a six-foot unit for measuring water depth.

indicators.note: over places crazy above the rest in this down entry

parts.note: crazy means mad
M is the abbreviation for Monsieur, a French gentleman

explanation.surface: A woman is wild about a man from France.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal address for a woman, and also a word for a woman generally.

indicators.note: spread signals the letters of the first word scattered and laid out anew
about signals turning the word for rumour back to front

parts.note: noise is talk or rumour, as in noised abroad

explanation.surface: Someone had circulated gossip about a liaison.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spread' rearranges HAD to ADH, and 'about' turns NOISE into ESION.
explanation.definitionFit: Adhesion is the act of sticking to something, an attachment.

definitions.meaning: a covered chair carried on poles, as a litter is
the 1870 Franco-Prussian battle at a French town

explanation.definitionFit: A sedan chair is a carried litter, and Sedan was the site of an 1870 battle in France.

clue.text: Symbol of Christ in unusual guise and form

indicators.note: unusual signals the following letters set in an unusual order

explanation.surface: A Christian symbol appears in a strange disguise and shape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'guise and form' reads as a pair, but only GUISE AND are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: The Lamb of God, Agnus Dei, is an image of Christ.

definitions.meaning: still to be done, not yet completed

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both not yet done and ruined, as in a fallen hero's cry.

clue.text: Fast movers before morning that may be found at sea

definitions.text: that may be found at sea

indicators.note: before places the jets ahead of morning

parts.note: jets are fast-moving aircraft
AM, ante meridiem, is morning

explanation.surface: Quick travellers set off before dawn on a sea voyage.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods thrown overboard from a ship, found floating or washed up from the sea.

clue.text: Compromise and put a stop to bad temper

parts.note: to put a stop to is to end
bad temper is anger

explanation.surface: Settle a dispute and stop the angry mood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Compromise' looks like a settlement, but it is the verb to put at risk.
explanation.definitionFit: To compromise safety is to expose it to danger.
